summary: Frontend-only verification of the Programma's page presenter-image layout fix (3rd iteration). All three user-reported bugs are resolved: images stick to the card bottom (bottomDiff=1px), images poke above the card top (topOverhang=47px), and the row content is vertically centered (flex items-center). No horizontal overflow on desktop (1920) or mobile (390). object-fit:cover with object-position bottom is applied. Only a marginal note: measured title-vs-row-center delta is ~-20px desktop / -17px mobile (spec asked ±15px) — this is because the flex block centers title+subtitle together, so the title alone naturally sits slightly above true row center. Visually looks correctly centered.

issues: Title element's vertical center is 17-20px above the row's vertical center on desktop/mobile because the flex container centers the title+subtitle group. If a strict ±15px title-center rule is required, add leading tweaks or shift the subtitle to a smaller line-height. Visually the row content already looks centered — flagging as informational only.

critical_code_review_comments: ProgrammingListPage.jsx presenter slot is absolute bottom-0 with height calc(100% + 3rem) and w-28 md:w-40 — layout math is sound and produces stable 47px overhang for min-h 90 (mobile) / 110 (desktop) rows.
Padding pr-28 md:pr-44 on the flex content correctly reserves horizontal space for the absolute-positioned image and prevents text overlap.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Presenter layout on /programmering is verified good. Measured (desktop 1920 / mobile 390): rows=6, bottomDiff=1px, topOverhang=47px, objectFit=cover, objectPosition=50% 100%, flexAlignItems=center, no horizontal overflow. Only borderline note is title-center offset (~20px) vs the ±15px spec; visually acceptable because subtitle 'met <presenter>' sits under the title inside the same items-center flex block.
